Context: 4. Absorption in ABs/PSUs, etc.

4. Encashment of 'Earned Leave' and 'Half Pay Leave'.The Government servant is entitled to encashment of earned leave and half pay leave to his credit on the date of such absorption subject to the total of earned leave / half pay leave at credit not exceeding 300 days in addition to the number of days for which encashment was availed along with LTC.  
- GID (5-C), Rule 39-D, CCS (Leave) Rules.
